title: Microsoft announces MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash coding models
summary: Microsoft announced MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash, two models aimed at AI-assisted software development, per the company&\#x27;s announcement post. The supplied material includes no benchmark figures, parameter counts, pricing, licensing terms, or release dates, so the claimed coding capabilities have not been independently verified. A commenter reported that GitHub Copilot was offering MAI Code 2 at a 50% discount on the day of release, and that the model resolved Python build problems under Windows WSL/Ubuntu, generated test cases that all passed, and fixed Azure Bicep deployment errors — a single anecdotal account rather than a measured evaluation.
